name: KPI cards
description: 2 to 4 KPI tiles with a big value and a green/red change arrow; also the metrics board for software companies (MRR, DAU, uptime, latency). Numeric values animate on change.

params.name: kpis
params.help: 1 to 4 rows: label, value (e.g. $48.2k, 99.98%, 182 ms), change (e.g. +12% or -3%; empty: none), note (e.g. vs last week; optional)

params.name: title
params.help: Small heading above the tiles (empty: none)

params.name: invert
params.help: Labels (comma-separated) where going down is good, e.g. p95 latency, Churn: their arrows are green when negative
